description: Create a Sulvo ad unit for an approved publisher. Requires SULVO_API_KEY (with the inventory:write scope) in the server environment, never passed as an argument — an account owner mints a write-scoped key in the Sulvo dashboard (Account Settings -> API key). The Sulvo account must be approved; the backend rejects unapproved accounts. Returns the created unit id and container root.

domain.description: Publisher domain the ad unit belongs to.

focusedAd.description: Only valid for the display type.

size.description: Ad size as width/height, or a responsive token like responsive_all. Required by the backend for most non-interstitial types.

name: create_sulvo_ad_unit
